skill.description: Research creators on Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou using SocialDataX account search, profiles, and recent content.

security_audit.summary: Two findings confirm unpinned npm package execution through npx -y; 53 findings reflect Markdown, legitimate credential references, account identifiers, or readable multilingual text. No evidence found of prompt injection, embedded secrets, or intentional data exfiltration in the supplied files. The external npm package and live API behavior were not inspected or executed.

remediation.issue: Both CLI example blocks automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest with access to the runtime environment.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify its integrity, and require approval before first execution; isolate the process and expose only necessary credentials.

content.user_title: Research Social Media Creators with SocialDataX
content.value_statement: Creator selection requires matching account identity with recent content evidence. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and organizes profiles, posts, and engagement signals for review.
actual_capabilities: Find candidate creators by account keyword, creator name, or topic on Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou.
Retrieve creator profiles through profile links, shared text, or supported platform account identifiers.
Collect recent creator posts with publication times, available engagement signals, media links, and content types.
Retrieve Douyin creator series with available titles, descriptions, covers, prices, and author information.
Continue paginated results using complete tokens while preserving request limits and identifying partial responses.
Organize visible account facts and content evidence separately from partnership or strategy judgments.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance.
Direct CLI use requires Node.js and npm; the documented MCP tools require a separately available server.
Available fields and coverage depend on service responses; partial results cannot establish a complete account history.
Does not log in, publish, engage, or modify accounts; Kuaishou series retrieval is not documented.

use_cases.title: Screen potential creator partners
use_cases.description: Find candidates within a topic, confirm account identity, and compare profile facts with recent content before planning outreach.

use_cases.title: Review competitor creator content
use_cases.description: Review a known creator's recent posts and engagement signals to identify recurring subjects and content formats.

use_cases.title: Document creator account evidence
use_cases.description: Compile available profile attributes, publication dates, and content links while recording missing fields and incomplete retrieval.

prompt_templates.title: Find a creator
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Xiaohongshu creators matching [name or topic]. Show one page of candidates and ask me to confirm ambiguous matches.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Research this [platform] creator: [profile link or shared text]. Summarize visible profile facts and identify unavailable fields.

prompt_templates.title: Review recent content
prompt_templates.prompt: Review posts from [creator profile] over the last 30 days, limited to three pages. Separate content evidence from strategy observations.

prompt_templates.title: Compare creator candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these creators for [campaign]: [profiles]. Use profiles and 30-day content, limit retrieval to three pages per creator, and flag partial results.

output_examples.input: Find Xiaohongshu creators covering home fitness.
output: Illustrative format only; no live account data was retrieved.
Candidate: [nickname]; account ID: [returned ID]; follower signal: [available value]; relevance: [matching topic evidence].
Next step: confirm the intended account before retrieving its profile or posts.

output_examples.input: Review this Douyin creator's last 30 days of content.
output: Illustrative format only; no live content data was retrieved.
Profile: [nickname and platform ID]; visible facts: [returned profile attributes].
Content evidence: [title], [publication time], [engagement signals], and [media link].
Coverage: [retrieved pages and date range]; missing fields and partial results: [reported gaps].
Strategy observation: [interpretation supported by the listed evidence].

best_practices: Confirm ambiguous creator matches and use the correct platform identifier before requesting further data.
Set page limits and preserve complete continuation tokens; report partial results and avoid restarting completed pages.
Keep API credentials private and review a pinned CLI package version before execution.
anti_patterns: Treating follower counts or a small post sample as proof of audience authenticity or campaign performance.
Confusing public Douyin account numbers with sec_user_id values, search keywords, or profile links.
Repeatedly retrying balance errors or restarting partial retrieval without preserving completed work.

faq.question: Which platforms are covered?
faq.answer: The documented workflows cover Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou creator searches, profiles, and posts. Douyin series retrieval is also included.

faq.question: What must I configure before use?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and ensure network access and sufficient balance. CLI use needs Node.js and npm; MCP use needs available tools.

faq.question: Can I start without a profile link?
faq.answer: Yes. Start with a creator name, account keyword, or topic. Confirm the correct candidate before retrieving more information.

faq.question: Does the skill modify social media accounts?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only. It does not log in, publish, like, comment, or change account settings.

faq.question: How are incomplete results handled?
faq.answer: Retain retrieved items and errors, label results incomplete, and continue with the returned token only when available and within original limits.

faq.question: What should happen when the balance is insufficient?
faq.answer: Stop repeated retries and use the SocialDataX billing page. After funding the correct account, resume according to the documented recovery rules.
